Issues found in the machine transcription

  • [Manual override] 42 alignment op(s) reclassified by you (local rescore, no AI).
  • 138 true substitutions (phonetic mishears), e.g. 'di' -> 'اگر', 'vi' -> 'بھی', 'thudda' -> 'ٹھڑا', 'thudda' -> 'ٹھڑا'.
  • 143 deletions (words missing from the machine output): 'eh', 'hai', 'hai', 'ditta', 'yaar', 'yaar'.

Suggestions to reduce WER

  • Improve acoustic robustness for mishears: cleaner audio (less noise, better mic), a domain lexicon / hotword list with the expected vocabulary, and a spelling-correction post-processing pass for known confusion pairs.
  • Check for audio dropouts / aggressive VAD trimming causing missed words; lower the VAD threshold or use overlapping chunks.

AI Analysis

Issues

  1. Insertion Errors: A significant insertion run ("اے نے نے اور نے...") suggests the model is hallucinating or generating filler sounds and words that do not exist in the source audio, likely due to noise or ambiguous acoustic features.

Suggestions

  1. Adjust Language Model Weights: Increase the penalty for inserting Urdu tokens when the surrounding context is predominantly English to reduce the "Urdu substitution" error.
  2. Improve Noise Robustness: The insertion run indicates the model is sensitive to background noise. Apply a higher noise suppression threshold or adjust the acoustic model's sensitivity to reduce hallucinations.
  3. Code-Switching Tuning: Configure the system to better detect language boundaries. If the audio contains distinct English phrases, the model should be tuned to prioritize English vocabulary for those segments.

Normalization applied: Unicode NFKC + Urdu character folding + diacritic removal, case-insensitive, punctuation/whitespace ignored, lines re-segmented on newlines / script switches / long sentences, transliteration-aware (Urdu ↔ Roman Urdu ↔ English), joined/split-word compound matching ("up on" = "upon", "ismein" = two Urdu words), spelled-acronym matching (ECP = ای سی پی), phonetic matching (kaun = kon, mujhe = mujhay) and semantic-aware matching. With AI Mode on, Urdu↔English lines are re-aligned by the LLM from the full sentence (logical reading order — not visual RTL/LTR position), so translation counterparts like آج="Today" and پاکستان="Pakistan" pair correctly despite different word order. Each column still displays words in their original sequence; colors and hover lines show the match. Weak AI guesses are re-checked and not marked correct. Numbers, currency and percent symbols are normalized before scoring ($5 = five dollars = پانچ ڈالر). WER counts only real errors.
